correctness.rationale: Independently order the simplex coordinates d_1≥⋯≥d_m and set Z_j=j(d_j−d_{j+1}), with d_{m+1}=0. The linear bijection from the ordered chamber again gives a uniform simplex vector. The maximum is Σ_i Z_i/i and the square sum is Σ_{j,k} Z_j Z_k/max(j,k). Expanding the third Dirichlet moments gives numerator 2(m+1)H_m+H_m²+H_m^(2) over m(m+1)(m+2). The marginal moments then give the claimed covariance and both variances. The covariance numerator starts at zero for m=1 and increases by 2(H_m−1)/m at m≥2; strict Cauchy–Schwarz makes the maximum variance positive. Harmonic asymptotics give the stated correlation and constant. For m=2 direct one-variable integration gives mixed moment 25/48 and covariance 1/48. Label circular spacings starting at a distinguished sampled point; their two symmetric statistics are independent of that label choice.
residual_risks: The conditional scaled vector in the threshold proof is used only when kt<1, and tail sums at t=0 are interpreted by continuity. The circular Dirichlet labeling need not hold when the first gap is forced to contain a deterministic spatial origin; the symmetric statistics remain as claimed.

This establishes equivalence of coverage, not which author or record obtained it first.
